definitionZh: *-moz-焦点-内置CSS伪元素是一个Mozilla扩展,代表按钮元素的内置焦点环以及输入元素的输入/按钮,输入/投递,输入/重置,以及输入/颜色类型.
sourceDefinition: The ::-moz-focus-inner CSS pseudo-element is a Mozilla extension that represents an inner focus ring of the button element as well as the input/button, input/submit, input/reset, and input/color types of the input element.
